exhibits.note: Every environment passed torchrl.envs.utils.check_env_specs with one and with three parallel copies. Shock standard deviations in percentage points.

exhibits.title: Transmission check: response to a sustained one-point rate increase
exhibits.note: Average response of the output gap (dy) and inflation (dpi) h quarters after the policy rate is raised by one percentage point and held there, shocks switched off, over every training-sample start. Passes: inflation is lower at h = 20.

exhibits.note: Field names of autofed.rl.RLConfig, whose documentation defines each. Rates and deviations in percent and percentage points; node grids are the hidden sizes searched; economies are those that passed the transmission check.

exhibits.note: Mean squared deviations over the simulated quarters; Loss weights them as the reward does. Penalty is the mean footnote-13 term, so Loss + Penalty is minus the mean reward.
